# Pages and content

## Main portfolio

### Copy voice

Write all visitor-facing narrative copy as Abhishek speaking directly to visitors (`I`, `me`, `my`). Avoid outsider narration such as “Abhishek is an ultra cyclist” or “he”. Headings, sport labels, event names, and SEO terms may use factual labels without changing the narrative voice.

Do not invent first-person stories, achievements, opinions, offers, or promises. Use `[Abhishek to provide: ...]` in source/content notes until Abhishek supplies the wording or confirms the facts. Never render authoring prompts on the live site; omit a personal-copy section or field until its real content is supplied.
